name: bakbak-mcp
description: Text to speech in Hindi, other Indian languages and English, saved as audio files on your computer.
long_description: The official Bakbak MCP server. Ask Claude to read text aloud in Hindi, Marathi, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Assamese, Gujarati, Nepali, Malayalam, Tamil or English, and it saves a WAV or MP3 file in your Documents/Bakbak folder. Choose from Bakbak's voices, slow down or speed up standard voices, and synthesize long texts (up to 50,000 characters) into one file. You need a Bakbak API key from https://bakbak.getraya.app; synthesis uses your Bakbak credits. It also carries Bakbak's developer documentation, so Claude can help you build with the Python and JavaScript SDKs, the LiveKit plugin, Pipecat, Twilio and other telephony, or the raw API.
